name: Scrollspy Accordion
description: Split scroll-driven showcase: a sticky left nav of three numbered accordion items synced via scroll-spy to a right column of tall image cards. The slot nearest viewport center activates its nav item (number, title, accent bar, and grid-row accordion) and lifts its card shadow.
interactions: scroll-spy: on scroll/resize and every rAF frame, the active item is the image slot whose vertical center is closest to viewport center

active nav item: number color idle->active, title color idle->primary, left accent bar transparent->primary, and a CSS grid-row accordion expands 0fr->1fr with the description fading 0->1, all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) verbatim
active image card transitions box-shadow soft-100 -> soft-600 over .4s
clicking a nav item scrolls its image slot into view (smooth; auto under reduced motion)
sticky nav pinned at top:20vh; stacks to one column under 800px (all reveals open)
prefers-reduced-motion: transitions disabled, smooth-scroll downgraded to auto
